g.text: Where the Click ID Lives — Browser to Platform
Three storage layers, each holding a piece of the attribution puzzle
LAYER 1 — URL (lives in the address bar)
Fragile: lost on any redirect, page refresh, or if the site strips params. Survives only until the tag stores it.
LAYER 2 — FIRST-PARTY COOKIE (lives on the site's domain)
Robust: survives navigation, refreshes, sub-domain hops. Read back at conversion time by the event tag.
LAYER 3 — PLATFORM BACKEND (lives in the ad system)
Permanent record: every click logged server-side, waiting for a matching conversion event inside the attribution window.
Sources: Conversion Linker tag sets _gcl_* cookies (support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/7549390);
